answer: Vest rewards like a river released through a dam: each epoch's payout unlocks 10% per epoch over 10 epochs. If a later audit links two identities, by reused signing nonces or near-identical answers, every unvested coin of both is burned. A farmer who races 40 accounts to the summit finds the vault hollow: a link found 6 epochs in forfeits at least 40% of every payout earned so far, so farming only pays if detection stays rare.
